noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

generator.description:
The target type to use the `generateImport` from with a component's metadata.
The `generateImport` function should return a {@link UiSdlImportResult}, and the
component in question will be passed a prop `generatedImports` which holds a map of `importName` to imported object.

title: A {@link Annotation} to specify that a component can dynamically generate static imports during the code-gen process.
name: Ann.UiImportGenerator
